content.short: Zharta is a lending protocol for instant NFT collateralized loans.
content.description: Zharta is a lending protocol that provides instant NFT-backed loans. It leverages artificial intelligence-based appraisals and DeFi liquidity pools to fund NFTs and optimize liquidity, with a strong emphasis on security. Any collector or investor who holds NFTs from supported collections can stake their assets to unlock liquidity, while the NFTs remain held in smart contracts as collateral throughout the loan period. This on-chain approach is designed to securely unlock liquidity for NFT holders.
